initial_state.tagline: A simulated ride and delivery app. Every driver, restaurant, address and fare here is invented; nothing moves and nothing is charged.

ride-uberx-annex-airport.title: UberX - Bridgetown Annex to Portland Airport (PDX)
ride-uberx-annex-airport.description: Everyday ride from the Northstar Bridgetown Annex to the airport. The estimate assumes the I-84 route; surge is shown before you confirm. Nearest driver is usually 3-5 minutes away on a weekday afternoon.

ride-comfort-annex-airport.title: Comfort - Bridgetown Annex to Portland Airport (PDX)
bullets: Set the temperature and quiet mode before pickup
ride-comfort-annex-airport.description: Same route as UberX, in a newer car with more legroom and the option to ask for a quiet ride. Drivers on Comfort have a 4.85 rating or better.

ride-xl-pearl-hawthorne.title: UberXL - Pearl District to Hawthorne (SE 34th and Hawthorne)
bullets: Pickup: NW 11th and Lovejoy, Portland OR
ride-xl-pearl-hawthorne.description: Van or large SUV for a group of up to six across the river to Hawthorne. The estimate crosses the Burnside Bridge; the Morrison route is about the same.

ride-black-downtown-vineyard.title: Uber Black - Downtown Portland to Tualatin Hills vineyards
bullets: Pickup: SW 5th and Morrison, Portland OR
Drop-off: 9200 Vineyard Ridge Rd, Tualatin Hills
ride-black-downtown-vineyard.description: Luxury sedan with a commercially licensed driver out to the vineyards on the west hills. Black rides can be scheduled up to 30 days ahead under Reserve.

ride-uberx-annex-hq.title: UberX - Portland Union Station to Bridgetown Annex
ride-uberx-annex-hq.description: The short hop from the train to the Annex, for anyone coming down from Seattle on the Cascades. Drivers wait in the pickup zone on NW Irving.

eats-pho-lovejoy.title: Pho Lovejoy - Beef pho (large) with a side of spring rolls
bullets: Rare beef and brisket, herbs on the side
Two spring rolls with nuoc cham
eats-pho-lovejoy.description: Large bowl of beef pho from the Lovejoy Street shop, broth packed separately so the noodles do not go soft on the way. Herbs, lime and jalapeno in a bag on top.

eats-hawthorne-burger.title: Hawthorne Burger Co. - Double smash burger combo
bullets: Two smashed patties, American cheese, house sauce
eats-hawthorne-burger.description: The combo from the Hawthorne window: two smash patties on a potato bun, shoestring fries and a drink. Ask for the pickles on the side in the notes if you want the bun to survive.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Arrived hot
reviews.body: Twenty-two minutes to the Annex and the fries were still crisp, which is rare.

eats-tacos-division.title: Taqueria Division - Three al pastor tacos with rice and beans
eats-tacos-division.description: Three al pastor tacos off the trompo at the Division Street cart, with a side of rice and refried beans. Tortillas are doubled so they hold.

eats-sushi-pearl.title: Pearl Sushi Bar - Salmon and avocado roll set (16 pieces)
bullets: Salmon avocado roll and a spicy tuna roll
eats-sushi-pearl.description: Two rolls, sixteen pieces, from the Pearl District bar, with miso soup, ginger and wasabi. Packed in a chilled bag.

eats-thai-belmont.title: Belmont Thai Kitchen - Green curry with chicken and jasmine rice
bullets: Spice level chosen at checkout, 1 to 5
eats-thai-belmont.description: Green curry with chicken, Thai eggplant and basil from the Belmont Street kitchen. Level 3 is medium for most people; level 5 is a commitment.

eats-pizza-alberta.title: Alberta Street Pizza - 16-inch pepperoni and hot honey
eats-pizza-alberta.description: Sixteen-inch New York style pie with cupped pepperoni and a hot honey drizzle after the oven. Ranch on the side is an extra $1.

eats-breakfast-stumptown.title: Rivergate Bakehouse - Breakfast sandwich and a 12 oz latte
bullets: Egg, cheddar and bacon on a brioche bun
eats-breakfast-stumptown.description: The morning order from the bakehouse two blocks from the Annex. Sandwich wrapped in foil, latte in a lidded cup with a splash guard. Available until 11:00.

eats-ramen-mississippi.title: Mississippi Ramen - Tonkotsu ramen with ajitama egg
bullets: Broth, noodles and toppings packed separately
eats-ramen-mississippi.description: Eighteen-hour pork bone broth from the Mississippi Avenue shop, with noodles and toppings in their own tubs so you assemble it hot. Comes with assembly instructions on the lid.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: The separate tubs work
reviews.body: Noodles were still springy after a thirty-minute ride. Best delivery ramen I have had.

scooter-30min.title: Scooter ride - 30 minutes, downtown Portland zone
bullets: $1.00 to unlock plus $0.30 a minute, about $9.95 for 30 minutes
Park in a marked corral to avoid the $5 fee
Zone: downtown, Pearl, inner east side
scooter-30min.description: Unlock a scooter with the app and ride within the downtown zone. The price shown is a 30-minute estimate. Riding outside the zone slows the scooter to walking pace.

scooter-daypass.title: Scooter day pass - unlimited 30-minute rides for 24 hours
bullets: Unlimited rides up to 30 minutes each
Rides over 30 minutes charged at $0.30 a minute
Zone: downtown, Pearl, inner east side
scooter-daypass.description: A day pass that covers every ride under 30 minutes for 24 hours from the first unlock. Worth it after the third ride.

reserve-black-airport.title: Reserve - Uber Black to PDX, scheduled pickup with 15-minute wait
bullets: Upfront price $69.00 from the Annex, includes the reservation fee
Cancel free until 1 hour before pickup
reserve-black-airport.description: A Black car booked in advance for the airport run, with an upfront price that does not change with surge and a driver assigned the night before. Flight number can be added so the pickup tracks delays.

reserve-comfort-early.title: Reserve - Comfort, early-morning pickup (04:00-06:00) anywhere in Portland
bullets: Upfront price $48.00 within the city, includes the reservation fee
Cancel free until 1 hour before pickup
reserve-comfort-early.description: For the first flight out. A Comfort car reserved the night before for any pickup between 04:00 and 06:00 within Portland city limits; the airport is the usual destination.
